t: You're looking at The Goatherd's Daughter, a sculpture by Charles Leonard Hartwell, an English sculptor who worked in bronze and marble. It also serves as a memorial. It commemorates Gertrude Baillie Weaver, who wrote under the name Gertrude Colmore. She was a suffragette, a writer and a campaigner for animal welfare, and she helped found the National Council for Animals' Welfare. Her husband, Harold Baillie Weaver, a barrister, is commemorated here too. The material I have on the sculpture itself is thin, so take a moment to look closely at the figure and see what it shows you.
